jobs.occupation: Quality Manager – Aerospace / EN9100 (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEAs Quality Manager, you are responsible for building, implementing and continuously improving our Quality Management System in line with EN 9100, laying the foundation for future certification and scalable organizational growth.Your primary focus lies on consolidating existing processes, identifying gaps and establishing a structured, audit-ready quality framework across the organization.This is not a purely documentation-focused role — you will take ownership of translating quality requirements into practical, day-to-day processes and ensuring that quality is effectively embedded in how we work.Operating in a startup environment, this role requires a high degree of flexibility, pragmatism and ownership. You will define structures while also working hands-on to implement them together with engineering, leadership and other key stakeholders.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Own and drive the development of an EN9100-compliant Quality Management System (QMS)
• Consolidate, structure and further develop existing processes across the organization
• Identify gaps and implement pragmatic, scalable solutions
• Define and maintain process documentation, procedures and quality standards
• Prepare and lead internal and external audits
• Align quality requirements with engineering, operations and certification activities
• Enable and train teams to ensure quality processes are understood and applied in practice
• Act as the central point of contact for all quality-related topics

WHAT YOU BRING
• Degree in Engineering, Quality Management or a related field
• Several years of experience in quality management within aerospace or a similarly regulated environment
• Strong experience with EN9100 / ISO 9001 and building or scaling QMS structures
• Solid understanding of aerospace regulatory frameworks
• Ideally, hands-on experience in Design Organization (DO) and/or Production Organization (PO) environments
• Proven ability to work both strategically and operationally in a growing organization
• Strong communication skills and ability to train and enable cross-functional teams
• Proactive, structured and solution-oriented mindset
• Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-changing startup environment
• Fluent English required; German is a plus

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides. A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn.
• Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution.
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation.
• Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen.
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board.

About usklick here!Built for purpose.When time matters.ERC was founded to close Europe's critical capability gap in the sky. Two full-scale demonstrators. Two EU records. Built for the missions that cannot wait.

jobs.description:
Specialist Investment Trading - Corporate Treasury Sales (f/m/d) Berlin

General information
Job ID 94299 Area Markets Products Start Date 01.07.2026 Contract Permanent Working Time Model Full-time Location(s) Berlin |

Corporate Treasury Sales partners with Germany’s leading corporates to navigate market risks with confidence - from  foreign exchange, interest rate and commodity solutions to securities and investment strategies. We combine sharp market expertise with the ability to design tailored OTC and investment products that truly move the needle for our clients. At CTS Germany, we bring this ambition to life through a high energy, team first culture: collaborative, curious, hands on and driven to deliver real impact. If you want to shape innovative Treasury solutions in a team that celebrates joint success, you will feel right at home with us.

What you can expect from us

- Advise corporate clients on investment and market risk solutions, securities, FX/MM and interest rate topics, with a clear commercial and closing-oriented focus.
- Drive the client risk management as well as investment business by identifying client needs, structuring tailored solutions, with main reponsibility for the full execution process.
- Develop and manage the client portfolio, taking responsibility for commercial results within your defined area.
- Closely monitor market developments to identify client opportunities and risk-related topics, driving initiatives forward with a strong execution mindset.
- Collaborate on business and sales strategies, bringing in your market insights and contributing to business unit-related strategy implementation.
- Unlock client potential and expand market share through proactive coverage, systematic follow-ups and high-quality advisory - while ensuring full regulatory compliance.
- Engage closely with internal partners to deliver comprehensive and tailored solutions for our clients.

What we expect from you

- Master’s degree in business administration, finance, economics, or a comparable field.
- Evidence of knowledge and experience according to § 87 Abs. 2 WpHG (2. FiMANoG) and §§ 1 & 6 WpHGMaAnzV.
- Proven sales expertise in investment and market risk solutions, securities, FX/MM and interest rate with the ability to advise clients and drive closings.
- Display a high level of commitment to proactive client outreach within the client portfolio to ensure best‑in‑class service and execution quality.
- Fluent German and English (spoken and written), with excellent communication and presentation skills.
- Very good understanding of business contexts.
- Show a keen interest in financial markets and up‑to‑date market movements.
- Thrive in a dynamic, fast‑moving environment.
- Good knowledge of accounting under HGB and IAS/IFRS.
- Familiarity with credit business, regulatory requirements (MiFID II, EMIR, Dodd Frank) and financial mathematics.
- Experience in foreign exchange and interest rate derivatives is a plus.
- High learning agility and an innovation and team-oriented mindset.

WELCOME TO BASF

In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
Join our international financial reporting team as a Financial Accountant. In this role, you are responsible for the general ledger and act as a crucial interface in finance.

- Business Transactions: As a Financial Accountant you process transactions within general ledger, lease and asset accounting, and reconcile with sub-ledgers.
- Financial Statements: Moreover, you prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements according to IFRS and local GaaP standards, and support income tax calculations.
- Reporting: You manage monthly group reporting for European BASF Group companies and respond to internal and external reporting inquiries.
- Central Contact: In addition, you serve as the main contact on accounting matters for subsidiaries, other departments at the hub, central financial units of BASF as well as the external auditor.
- Project Involvement: You actively participate in projects and collaborate on the technical, procedural and cultural development of our organization.
- degree in business administration / apprenticeship with a focus on accounting or an equivalent degree
- good knowledge of MS Office, especially Excel and ideally experience with SAP R/3 and S/4HANA
- very good knowledge of English and Polish, German language skills are a plus
- high motivation to achieve joint success in a team
- independent way of working and analytical thinking characterize your working style
- you are enthusiastic about automation and digitization of processes

WHAT WE OFFER

- Gross annual salary (full-time): 40.000 - 46.000 €, depending on qualification and work experience. In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success as well as individual performance
- Structured onboarding including a buddy to help ease your transition into the BASF world
- Modern sustainable office building in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg with flexible working options, rooftop terrace and cafeteria for innovative and team-focused collaboration - get to know our location
- Development discussions and programs so that you can reach your full potential
- Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs
- Location-independent work models with defined days of presence in Berlin and place of residence in Germany - here a first impression

HOW TO REACH US

- Jennifer Weiz (Talent Acquisition), jennifer.weiz@basf.com, Tel.:+49 30 2005-56454 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are welcome to book an online appointment
- You can also reach our recruiting team on.basf.com/contact
- First information about our application process can be found here on.basf.com/application
